Completion evidence map for the four previously unmet criteria (verified on merged `origin/main` dcc90ced4):

1. review-plan deterministic mixed-gate regression: `tests/unit/test_unified_criteria.py::test_project_criteria_explicitly_opt_into_one_or_both_review_types` constructs plan-only, code-only, and both-gate project criteria, calls both effective registries, and proves each selected gate excludes the other-gate-only id without raising. `tests/unit/test_unified_criteria.py::test_legacy_activation_isolated_without_importing_other_gate` launches a fresh Python process importing only plan-review and proves a code-review-only activated criterion is skipped without CriteriaError. Current exact focused command `pytest -q tests/unit/test_unified_criteria.py tests/unit/test_criteria_overlay.py tests/unit/test_criterion_preview.py tests/unit/test_project_portability_docs.py` -> 72 passed in 18.75s. This is the deterministic registry seam that previously made `review-plan` unsigned INDETERMINATE before any LLM call.

2. documentation + canonical gates: canonical opt-in mapping and legacy compatibility are documented in `docs/adr/0015-project-supplied-criteria.md` and the user-facing example in `docs/plan-review-gate.md`. Implementation validation previously recorded on this ticket: TDD RED 6 intended failures/37 passes; focused GREEN 116 passes; `make lint` passed; mypy passed across 379 files; `make test` passed 7,252 tests with 29 skipped/114 deselected. Current merged-main safety run for the dependent recovery change also passed `make lint`, mypy across 380 files, and `make test` with 7,280 passed/29 skipped/114 deselected.

3. landed through Gerrit: https://rebar.solutions.navateam.com/c/rebar/+/983 (`f3dbe32b0`, parser/scope) is MERGED with LLM-Review +1, Verified +1, zero unresolved comments; CI run 30286079877 succeeded. https://rebar.solutions.navateam.com/c/rebar/+/984 (`bc838aed2`, explicit project overlay migration) is MERGED with LLM-Review +1, Verified +1, zero unresolved comments; CI run 30287564790 succeeded. Both commits are reachable from current `origin/main` dcc90ced4.

4. bug-resolution reproduction: at bad SHA 20e586c9e the fresh plan-review resolver raised CriteriaError because global activate contained code-review-only `project.review-phase-boundaries`, producing unsigned INDETERMINATE with llm_ran=false. On merged main the two regression paths above return normally: plan registry contains plan-only/both ids and excludes code-only; fresh plan-review-only process exits 0 with the code-only id absent. The reported self-hosted claim-gate defect therefore no longer reproduces, while absent routing for every supported gate and malformed selected-gate routing still raise as required.
